claim: When a Kinesis data stream is the source, Kinesis Data Streams encrypts the data with a KMS key before storing it and decrypts it when the Firehose stream reads it. Firehose buffers the data in memory and delivers it without storing unencrypted data at rest.

evidence.quote: When you send data from your data producers to your data stream, Kinesis Data Streams encrypts your data using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key before storing the data at rest. Amazon Data Firehose buffers the data in memory based on the buffering hints that you specify. It then delivers it to your destinations without storing the unencrypted data at rest.
